palette: rosewood gift hall, plum revocation seals, moss refusal ribbons, gold interest rails, bone paper, walnut ink
typography: gift-loan headings on rosewood rail tabs, bone chips with plum and gold seals
composition: a gift-and-loan hall where two revocation gates sit side by side, the statutory revocation runs a one-year six-month clock into take-back outcomes, three gift lanes sequence their promise steps, the loan desk separates practice from consensus formation over three invalidity gateways, and the interest board splits presumption from capped rates
surface: bone paper dossiers, rosewood desk rails, gold interest rulers
motion: gift tokens pass revocation gates that void or preserve the contract, the statutory clock lights one-year and six-month windows before take-back stamps, lane steps fire in legal order, loan coins arrive at accounts to form contracts and bounce through invalidity gates, and the rate gauge marks the four-times-LPR redline
transition: the rosewood hall floor, plum seals and gold rails persist while gates, clocks, lanes and boards are re-dressed between scenes
